  • 4 types of interchangeable faces
  • Interchangeable right arm part

products.description: From "Saint Seiya: Saintia Sho" comes Equuleus before the heroine Shoko received her Cloth from her elder sister Kyoko! The set includes three pairs of optional hands, optional hair parts, two optional expression parts, a Cloth set, and a frame for Object mode (including power-up parts).

products.description: One of the seven warriors of Asgard and a reincarnation of the legendary Siegfried, Dubhe Alpha Siegfried joins Saint Cloth Myth EX two years after the revelation of the prototype! Scylla Io is the protector of the pillar of the South Pacific Ocean.

In the underwater sanctuary of Emperor Poseidon, Andromeda Shun heads to the South Pacific pillar when his chain suddenly feels a hostile presence. He launches his attack Nebula Chain but a young woman in prayer appears and the Knight retains his shot.
